Maharashtra Approves Major Road Link Project

The Indian state of Maharashtra has approved a major road link project worth Rs 1,722 crore to connect the Versova-Bandra Sea Link with the Mumbai Coastal Road. The project aims to improve connectivity and reduce traffic congestion in the region. The approval comes after changes were made to the draft plan (DP-2034) for the Versova area.
